description: Header file defining the VideoDecoder class for Android shared video decoding, including class declarations, member variables, and method signatures related to video decoding functionality within the Starboard platform.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for Android shared video decoding, managing codec initialization, input/output processing, surface management, and error reporting within the Starboard platform.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Enqueues input buffers for decoding.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target (texture or surface).

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames.

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the preroll timeout duration.

methods.name: is_decoder_created
methods.description: Checks if the decoder has been successfully created.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTargetSizeAndContentRegion_Locked
methods.description: Updates the size and content region of the decode target.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for decoding.

methods.name: OnNewTextureAvailable
methods.description: Callback when a new texture is available.

methods.name: ProcessOutputBuffer
methods.description: Processes a decoded output buffer.

methods.name: OnEndOfStreamWritten
methods.description: Handles end of stream signaling.

methods.name: RefreshOutputFormat
methods.description: Refreshes the output format after format change.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Performs periodic decoder tasks.

methods.name: OnFlushing
methods.description: Handles flushing state.

methods.name: TryToSignalPrerollForTunnelMode
methods.description: Signals preroll completion in tunnel mode.

methods.name: IsFrameRenderedCallbackEnabled
methods.description: Checks if frame rendered callback is enabled.

methods.name: OnFrameRendered
methods.description: Callback when a frame has been rendered.

methods.name: OnTunnelModePrerollTimeout
methods.description: Handles tunnel mode preroll timeout.

methods.name: OnTunnelModeCheckForNeedMoreInput
methods.description: Checks if more input is needed in tunnel mode.

methods.name: OnVideoFrameRelease
methods.description: Handles release of video frames.

methods.name: OnSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles surface destruction event.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error with a specific error code and message.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Releases and cleans up the codec resources.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Attempts to initialize the media codec with given video stream info.
